backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining Order types and implementing order management functions (submitOrder, getOrderById, getAllOrders) with validation, storage in a Map, and auto-incrementing order IDs.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module with a run function that handles actor upgrades, currently returning an empty actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: weight-based pricing display, Buy Now button with customer detail form, and backend order submission integration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of frontend files describing the Kitchen Rahasya spice shop application with brand styling, navigation, shop page with order forms, and backend integration hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with Kitchen Rahasya brand color variables in OKLCH format for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and UI component colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Kitchen Rahasya application with viewport meta tag and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes (Home, Shop, About, Contact), React Query client, and shared Layout with Navigation, Footer, and Toaster components.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Kitchen Rahasya branding, contact information (phone: 7002443549, location: Shrimadhopur, Sikar, Rajasthan), quick links, social media icons, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with Kitchen Rahasya logo, desktop and mobile menus, active route highlighting, and hamburger menu toggle for mobile devices.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook for managing backend actor instances with Internet Identity authentication, creating anonymous or authenticated actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query mutation hook for submitting orders to the backend actor, with automatic query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom Kitchen Rahasya brand colors (deep red, golden yellow, forest green) defined as CSS variables for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutUs.tsx: About page component describing Kitchen Rahasya's story, traditional sil-batta grinding methods, and brand values with decorative icons and styled sections.
frontend/src/pages/ContactUs.tsx: Contact page with a validated form (name, email, message) and contact information display, including simulated form submission with success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage component featuring a hero banner with call-to-action, and a features section highlighting natural ingredients, traditional methods, and craftsmanship.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop page component displaying three spice products (Red Chilli, Turmeric, Coriander) with size selection (100g/200g/500g), pricing, and a buy-now dialog that collects customer name and address before submitting orders via the useSubmitOrder hook.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, custom font families (Inter, Playfair Display, Poppins), extended shadows, animations, and responsive container settings.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting Kitchen Rahasya e-commerce site architecture, brand identity (traditional Indian spices), color palette, contact details, product pricing, and implemented features including Home, Shop, About, and Contact pages.
